originalAlarm.description: Value stored to 'm_has_modinfo' is never read

reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file and variable as PRODUCT_34 (5275b1e49f6.c), alarm at line 16 (the if-branch assignment 'm_has_modinfo = 0') vs line 18 (the else-branch). When CONFIG_FEATURE_INSMOD_VERSION_CHECKING is true, m_has_modinfo is assigned in the conditional block but never subsequently read in the simplified file. In the real BusyBox insmod_main() code, m_has_modinfo is used extensively throughout the function. The simplified file stripped those uses. This is a simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug (UndeclaredIdentifier: k_crcs used when VERSION_CHECKING is disabled) is a different issue.
